_note: armature's declaration — the SECOND repo to adopt these conventions, and the one whose adoption was the extraction's gate condition. Conventions are a FULL declaration: record-index supplies no default for anything absent here, so every field is stated even where the answer is 'armature has none of these'. Where a value differs from facet's, the difference is a fact about armature's record and is commented.

corpora._record_top_files: HANDOFF.md is armature's dispatch record and carries no `## Session handoff` headers — it is indexed as prose rather than as handoff rows, which is a difference from facet, not a defect.
corpora._prose_files: EMPTY BY DECLARATION, not by omission. armature has no docs/context-architecture.md, no docs/handbook/, no docs/profiles-design.md, no docs/style-registers.md. Declaring the emptiness is a different statement from leaving the key out, and only one of them is a declaration.
corpora._profile_files: EMPTY BY DECLARATION. armature has no profiles registry and is not expected to grow one; this is exactly the case that used to be a CONVENTIONS_INVALID refusal rather than an empty table.
corpora._experiments_table: EMPTY BY DECLARATION. armature has no docs/experiments/README.md, so every experiment row comes from disk and the absence is reported by verify rather than raised on.
corpora._sweep_extra_dirs: the published Starlight handbook, swept so a stale sync is visible.

discovery._kickoff_doc: MATCHES NOTHING TODAY, and that is measured rather than assumed: armature has zero `E\d\d-*kickoff*.md` documents — its dispatches are docs/dispatches/S\d\d-*.md and its handoff record is HANDOFF.md. The pattern is declared in facet's shape so that a kickoff, if armature ever writes one, is discovered rather than silently missed.
discovery._ruling_arc: STEM-DERIVED, and load-bearing here specifically: armature carries FOUR E02 ruling documents (bridge, canon, closing, halt). Stem-derived they are four distinct arcs numbering from 1 independently. Keyed on the E-number they would be one arc and — once the second header form below is admitted — would collide on rulings 1–7 from three documents at once. Measured before this file was written.

headers._ruling: TWO FORMS, and this is the field the extraction added a list for. armature's closing rulings write `## Ruling N` (facet's form). Its EARLY ruling documents — E01, E02-bridge, E02-halt — write `## N. RULING — …`, and only the sections that announce RULING are rulings: those files also carry `## N.` sections that are ordinary prose, and admitting every `## N.` would mint rulings out of section headings. The `## N.` headings that are NOT admitted are counted and named by verify's ruling-header vocabulary rather than silently dropped.
headers._addenda: armature writes no post-ingest addenda. Declared empty.
headers._amendment: armature writes no blockquoted amendment headers. Declared empty.

vocabularies._verdicts: armature's own shouted verdicts, MEASURED against its record rather than copied from facet: ADMISSIBLE and CORRECTED are armature's and are absent from facet's list; facet's DESIGNATED/ADOPTED/MINTED/BANKED have no site here and are not carried. Ordered most- to least specific; the first hit in a holding wins.
vocabularies._artifact_kinds: ⚑ THE VIDEO EXTENSIONS ARE THE POINT. facet's map carries no mp4/mkv/webm/mov, and running facet's parsers over armature dropped six artifact mentions silently — in the repo whose entire product is video. That silent drop is why verify now counts unrecognised inputs, and this is the declaration that fixes it here.
vocabularies._phenomenon_markers: EMPTY BY DECLARATION. Measured: none of facet's seven naming verbs fires anywhere in armature's record — 0 of 7. armature does not mint phenomena in that house style, so it declares no markers and gets no phenomena table rather than inheriting a vocabulary that describes another repo's prose.

_laws: armature's laws are inherited from facet's law book and cite arcs across the whole range, so the pattern is the general one rather than facet's frozen E01–E15 — which, measured, no longer covers even facet's own arcs.

verify._count_checks: The verifier's OWN greps, written independently of the parser's patterns so the two are not one implementation checking itself. Every leg names a file that exists today and a count the record carries; a leg that grepped a file which is not there would be a check that cannot fail.
verify._sequences: Pre-registered bounds, one per arc that carries numbered rulings. The record carrying MORE than a bound prints as a completeness note; it never silently widens the gate.
verify._handoff_coverage: NULL BY DECLARATION — armature has no `## Session handoff` documents at all, so a coverage check here would be a check that cannot fail.
verify._experiment_coverage: NULL BY DECLARATION for the same reason as above: armature's arcs are still opening and a fixed span would go stale the week it was written. The record is moving under live seats.
verify._seeded: THE EXTERNAL VERIFIER'S KEY. Every phrase here ran report-only through `q` FIRST and its target ranked <= 3 BEFORE the row entered the gate — seeds are ruled in from measured ranks, never added and then tuned until green. Populated in the commit that measured them.
